_pool_value_adoption_note: RE-STAMPED 528 -> 299 by the #274 adoption mop-up act (owner word 2026-07-30). The 30/7 rederivation moved the pool price; the release-active artifact engine/rl_after/pvc_curve_v2.json carries pool_value 299 and self-documents the move at stamp.prev_pool_value = 528. This file is a MIRROR of that artifact, and it was left at 528 when the adoption landed - a stale duplicate, not a second decision. The split_note below is preserved verbatim as the history of THE SPLIT, where 528 was correct; it describes the domain re-issue, not this value. split_note: THE PRICING SPLIT (owner ruling; RULEBOOK v2.1 law 4 G-MONO, amended 2026-07-28). The contract is re-issued because the ADOPTED CURVE'S DOMAIN changed, not its values: the national curve now covers picks 1-64 and every selection past 64 enters the pool, valued by position with order of selection carrying no value. There is no price for pick 70. Values over 1-64 are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the superseded artifact; pool_value is that artifact's own value at index 65. No curve was refitted. A re-issue is correct here precisely because the contract exists to stop the curve moving SILENTLY - this move is ruled, declared, and recorded below.
